content.title: About
content.content: Multigrain oatmeal is a blend of whole oat flakes, wheat, barley, rye and other grains. The product is rich in complex carbohydrates, fiber, B‑vitamins and minerals, making it a nutritious and filling breakfast.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Oatmeal contains beta‑glucans – soluble fiber that helps lower cholesterol levels.
A multigrain mix provides a broader spectrum of nutrients compared with plain oats.
Oat flakes can be used not only in hot porridge but also in cold dishes, smoothies and baked goods.
Heat processing retains most B‑vitamins, while some vitamin C is lost.
Oatmeal has long been considered a "champion's breakfast" because of its sustained energy release.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Beta‑glucans help reduce LDL‑cholesterol, which is beneficial for heart health.

items.title: Blood sugar regulation
items.content: Complex carbs and soluble fiber slow glucose absorption, preventing sharp blood‑sugar spikes.

items.title: Improves digestion
items.content: Fiber promotes intestinal motility and supports a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Thiamine, riboflavin and niacin aid energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Minerals for bone health
items.content: Magnesium, phosphorus and iron contribute to strong bones and muscle function.

items.title: Grain allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to oats or other grains in the blend.

items.title: Gluten content
items.content: Multigrain oatmeal often contains traces of gluten from wheat, barley or rye, making it unsuitable for people with celiac disease.

items.title: High glycemic index with added sugar
items.content: Adding large amounts of sugar or honey to the prepared porridge can raise its glycemic index.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Cook oatmeal in water or milk for 5‑10 minutes, then add fruit, nuts, honey or spices to taste. It can also be prepared as cold "overnight oats" by mixing with yogurt and refrigerating overnight.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a dry, cool place, tightly sealed. After opening, transfer to an airtight container and use within 3‑4 months. Discard if you notice moldy or rancid odors.
